title: Gitignore runner runtime artifact directories
problem: Runner artifact directories (specs/, plans/, executions/, hardens/, reports/) are tracked in git, causing artifact loss when the orchestrator switches between feature branches and master during resume after failure. Docs already describe these as git-ignored but .gitignore does not reflect that.
description:
Runner orchestrator artifact loss on resume across branch switches.

When the runner runs the executor, it creates a feature branch (runner/<uuid>) and commits step changes there. The auto_harden stage also commits fix rounds to that branch. If the harden process touches tracked runner artifacts (specs/, plans/, executions/), those become committed only on the feature branch.

When approval merges the feature branch back to master, that's fine for a fresh end-to-end run. But if a stage fails and the runner is later resumed, the orchestrator may switch back to master to find tracked artifacts missing (they only exist on the feature branch).

Reproduced on ticket ead3d93f: harden's round 1 fix commit included runner/specs/<uuid>.json. After harden passed, the approval stage on master couldn't find spec/plan/execution files because they were branch-only. Manual fix: git checkout <branch> -- runner/specs/<uuid>.json runner/plans/<uuid>.json runner/executions/<uuid>.json, then commit them to master before re-running approval.

Possible fixes:
1. Gitignore runner/specs/, runner/plans/, runner/executions/, runner/hardens/, runner/reports/ — they're regenerable artifacts, not source. Only intake/ should be tracked.
2. Have run.py auto-restore missing tracked artifacts from the runner branch on resume.
3. Have auto_harden refuse to commit anything in runner/specs|plans|executions paths so the artifacts stay on master only.

Option 1 is the cleanest — these are runtime artifacts and should not be in git history. Note that file-storage.md docs already describe these as 'git-ignored except runner/intake/' but the .gitignore doesn't actually exclude them.
scope: Modify .gitignore to exclude runner/specs/, runner/plans/, runner/executions/, runner/hardens/, runner/reports/. Remove these directories from git tracking via git rm --cached. Verify runner/intake/ and runner/backlog/ remain tracked.
